name: Kitagawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kitagawa village emblem in white: a ring open at the top beneath a winged device with pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kitagawa, a village in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 February 1890.

features.role: Kitagawa village emblem — a ring open at the top beneath a winged device with pointed strokes
